page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is an x86_64 bare-metal-like instance configured with 128 dedicated physical cores and 128 vCPUs, operating with a single thread per core configuration. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding 6.0 GB of RAM per physical core. For acceleration, the instance integrates four NVIDIA A10 GPUs, providing a combined total of 96 GB of VRAM.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external network-attached storage solutions for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between the instance and external storage or other network resources. The KVM-virtualized environment ensures dedicated resource allocation without hyper-threading, which eliminates resource contention at the core level.

Given the combination of 128 dedicated cores, 768 GB of RAM, and four NVIDIA A10 GPUs, this server is designed for GPU-accelerated workloads, deep learning inference, and parallel computing tasks. The high density of compute and GPU resources offers qualitative cost efficiency for enterprise-scale parallel processing and machine learning workloads, though the lack of local storage requires careful architectural planning for I/O-heavy applications.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is a high-performance, GPU-accelerated instance featuring 128 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture with a single thread per core. It is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory and four NVIDIA A10 GPUs, delivering a total of 96 GB of VRAM. The instance operates on a KVM hypervisor and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. Notably, the instance does not include local storage, meaning all data persistence relies on network-attached storage. This hardware profile is optimized for parallel computing, deep learning inference, and graphics-intensive workloads. The dedicated core allocation ensures predictable performance by eliminating hyper-threading overhead, making it highly efficient for resource-intensive enterprise applications.
